desc: The Bosch 30-inch Speed Oven 800 Series can prepare a wide range of meals with a 1.6-cu. ft. speed microwave that combines a microwave and convection oven for a broad variety of cooking options. This 2-in-1 convection and microwave oven offers you a wide range of cooking options: the nine SpeedChef cooking cycles help prepare your foods quickly and the ten microwave power levels let your cook, defrost, or reheat food.
hl: Appliances are completely flush with your cabinetry, so they blend in beautifully and never protrude.
